unit.title: The Future, Personal Goals and B1 Integration

theory.title: Repaso final del nivel B1
theory.explanation: This final checkpoint reviews the complete B1 course and introduces no new grammar. Use the most suitable language to talk about personal experiences, relationships, work, travel, health, media, consumer choices and global communication.
theory.tip: El objetivo final es comunicarte con autonomía: expresar ideas, narrar experiencias, justificar opiniones y resolver situaciones habituales.

patterns.label: Repaso final del nivel B1 · 1
patterns.pattern: I've gained confidence since I started the course.
examples:

→ He ganado confianza desde que empecé el curso.

patterns.label: Repaso final del nivel B1 · 2
patterns.pattern: If I had more time, I would practise every day.
examples:

→ Si tuviera más tiempo, practicaría todos los días.

patterns.label: Repaso final del nivel B1 · 3
patterns.pattern: The documents must be checked before they are sent.

The documents must be checked before they are sent.
→ Los documentos deben revisarse antes de enviarlos.

patterns.label: Repaso final del nivel B1 · 4
patterns.pattern: She asked me to explain what had happened.
examples:
She asked me to explain what had happened.
→ Ella me pidió que explicara lo que había pasado.

patterns.label: Repaso final del nivel B1 · 5
patterns.pattern: Despite the difficulties, we found a solution.
examples:
Despite the difficulties, we found a solution.
→ A pesar de las dificultades, encontramos una solución.

patterns.label: Repaso final del nivel B1 · 6
patterns.pattern: By the end of the year, I will have reached my goal.
examples:
By the end of the year, I will have reached my goal.
→ Para finales de año, habré alcanzado mi objetivo.

patterns.label: Repaso final del nivel B1 · 7
patterns.pattern: We help each other when we work in a team.
examples:
We help each other when we work in a team.
→ Nos ayudamos mutuamente cuando trabajamos en equipo.

patterns.label: Repaso final del nivel B1 · 8
patterns.pattern: Could you tell me when the meeting starts?
examples:
Could you tell me when the meeting starts?
→ ¿Podrías decirme cuándo empieza la reunión?

patterns.label: Repaso final del nivel B1 · 9
patterns.pattern: The more you practise, the more confident you become.
examples:
The more you practise, the more confident you become.
→ Cuanto más practicas, más confianza adquieres.

patterns.label: Repaso final del nivel B1 · 10
patterns.pattern: In the end, clear communication makes a difference.
examples:
In the end, clear communication makes a difference.
→ Al final, una comunicación clara marca la diferencia.

content.passage: Over the course, learners have developed the skills they need to communicate more independently. They have practised describing experiences, explaining opinions and solving everyday problems. Some activities were challenging; however, regular practice helped everyone improve. By the end of the course, learners will have completed a range of tasks and gained confidence. The most important lesson is that clear communication, curiosity and practice make a real difference.

items.prompt: Summarise how your English has improved.
items.modelAnswer: During this course, I have become more confident using English in everyday situations. I can describe experiences, explain opinions and ask for information more politely. I have also learned how to talk about plans, solve problems and work with other people. Some grammar points were difficult at first, but regular practice helped me improve. In the future, I would like to use English more often at work and when travelling.

A: What are your plans for the future? B: I want to achieve my goals and continue making progress.
